features: 48MP DIGITAL CAMERA FOR EVERYDAY MEMORIES — Capture photos up to 48MP with a fun compact point-and-shoot camera made for everyday photography. From friends and family to college, parties and holidays, PLAYZZ makes it easy to carry a dedicated digicam for spontaneous moments.

180° FLIP SCREEN MADE FOR SELFIES & VLOGGING — Flip the screen up to 180° so you can see yourself while framing selfies, group photos and videos. The front-facing screen makes the camera especially convenient for casual vlogging, travel diaries and creating content without needing someone behind the camera.

1080P VIDEO FOR VLOGS & EVERYDAY CLIPS — Switch from photos to video and record in 1080P (1920×1080) or 720P (1280×720). Capture short vlogs, celebrations, outings, travel moments and everyday clips with one compact digital camera.

BUILT-IN FILL LIGHT FOR LOW-LIGHT MOMENTS — Don't let dim indoor lighting or evening plans stop you from taking a picture. The integrated fill light adds extra illumination when needed, making it useful for selfies, portraits, parties and casual photography in lower-light environments.

8GB MEMORY CARD INCLUDED + TYPE-C CONNECTIVITY — Start capturing memories without immediately purchasing a separate card. An 8GB memory card is included, while USB Type-C connectivity provides convenient charging and connection. The camera also includes a charging cable, lanyard and manual.

COMPACT POINT & SHOOT CAMERA FOR BEGINNERS — PLAYZZ keeps everyday photography simple and fun with a self-timer, flip-screen design and straightforward controls. Its colourful compact design makes it a great everyday camera for beginners, teens and students, whether you're travelling, hanging out with friends or discovering photography for the first time.
